methodology.scienceNote: Every feature is grounded in real research. Expand any section to learn more.

ws1.title: Behavioral Science Foundations
ws1.blurb: How naming emotions and building self-efficacy drives real change
ws1.summary: Affect labeling reduces amygdala reactivity by up to 50% (Lieberman et al., 2007). Self-efficacy is built through mastery experiences, not encouragement (Bandura, 1977). Readiness for change follows predictable stages (Prochaska & DiClemente, 1983).

ws2.title: Narrative Identity & Desistance
ws2.blurb: Why telling your story in a new way changes outcomes
ws2.summary: People who construct redemption sequences (bad→good arcs) show higher well-being and generativity (McAdams, 2013). Desistance from crime correlates with generative identity construction (Maruna, 2001). Autonomy is a core psychological need (Deci & Ryan, 2000).

methodology.rulesTitle: How t.ROY Is Built to Help
methodology.rulesNote: t.ROY follows strict rules designed to respect your time, your autonomy, and your privacy.

r1.name: Invite naming, prompt causal reasoning
r1.clientFacing: t.ROY helps you find the words for what you’re going through.

r2.name: Offer options, never prescribe
r2.clientFacing: You always decide. t.ROY shows options, never tells you what to do.

r3.name: Reflect and affirm
r3.clientFacing: t.ROY listens to what you say and reflects it back clearly.

r4.name: Meet readiness level
r4.clientFacing: t.ROY meets you where you are. No pressure, no rushing.

r5.name: Explain yourself
r5.clientFacing: t.ROY always tells you why it’s suggesting something.

r6.name: Scaffold then fade
r6.clientFacing: More help when you’re starting out, less as you get comfortable.

r7.name: Process praise only
r7.clientFacing: t.ROY celebrates what you do, not labels about who you are.

r8.name: Cultural sensitivity
r8.clientFacing: No assumptions about your background. Plain language. Always.

r9.name: Know when to connect humans
r9.clientFacing: If you need more than a tool can give, t.ROY connects you to real people.

r10.name: Never share personal data in responses
r10.clientFacing: t.ROY never repeats your personal details back to you in chat.

consent.title: Your record answers and AI
consent.p1: The record questions ask where it comes up, the kind of record, how long ago, supervision, and your own words. Every one can be skipped. This plan never asks what happened.
consent.p2: With your yes, those answers can go to an AI service (our main one, or a backup if it is down) to read your plan back to you, and your own record words go into practice with t.ROY. AI never rewrites your record lines. Without your yes, no record answer goes to any AI.
consent.p3: Your yes is saved to your account with the date, and you can take it back here any time.
consent.p4: Your record answers and your record words are never saved: not in your plan, not in your Library, not with a job application. Copy or download them before you leave the page.

practice.preparing: Preparing a response to your answer
practice.privacy: This is a safe space to practice. In text practice we keep the role, the kind of practice and t.ROY's feedback, never a transcript of your answers, so the app can track your progress. In voice practice, what was said is kept as text only when you turn saving on, and we never keep the audio. No program or employer can read your practice. If you share your progress with a program, it sees how many sessions you have done.
